exposure: Postoperative diagnosis of placenta accreta, increta, or percreta
cohort: 66 patients with placenta accreta who had received a C-section
finding: More blood loss was reported in patients with a history of uterine scarring and C-sections should be limited in these patients.
mod_finding: The study found that patients with a history of uterine scarring had more blood loss and a higher incidence of hysterectomy after cesarean section for placenta accreta.
